# What does this pasture carry, and what rent works for both sides?

> Free grazing lease calculator for ranchers and landowners: AUMs and head your pasture carries, rent per AUM, per head and per acre, the hay-feeding break-even, and the rent range where both sides win. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
